50526854.protein: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3
50526854.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to STAT3 (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli expression system by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.2.3. Character: SPR experiment was carried out at 25 °C using a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare, USA). SPR buffers, regeneration solutions and sensor chips were purchased from GE Healthcare, USA. Recombinant STAT3 protein was expressed in Escherichia Coli system. The surface of research-grade CM5 chip was activated by 1-ethyl-3 (3-dimethylaminopropyl)-carbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC)/N-hydroxysuccinimide (DNS) amine coupling following a standard Biacore protocol. For immobilization of protein, STAT3 was injected in 100 μL of 10 mM sodium acetate (pH4.5, flow rate: 10 μL/min). After immobilization, the surface was blocked by 1 M ethanolamine-HCl at pH 8.5 for 13 min. For interaction measurements, compounds were dissolved by DMSO and diluted by HBS-EP buffer (running buffer, containing 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.05% (v/v) Surfactant P20, 10 mM Heps (pH7.4)). Various concentrations of compounds were injected over this interaction surface for 30 s with a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The sensor surface was regenerated between sample injections with running buffer for 45 s at the flow rate of 30 μL/min. An equivalent volume of compounds was injected over a chip surface with no STAT3 immobilized to serve as a blank channel for the background subtraction. All experiments were repeated three times. The Kd (equilibrium dissociation constant) for each interaction were determined by globally fitting the experimental data with Biacore T200 evaluation software 2.0 (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Figure 7. SPR characterization of compound 13r with STAT3. Concentration from top to bottom: 1.25 μM, 0.625 μM, 0.313 μM, 0.156 μM, 0.078 μM.
original_paragraph.Results - 2.2.5. Interaction of compound: The binding interaction of 13r to STAT3 protein was performed using a Biacore T200 optical biosensor. The binding responses were shown in Figure 7. Injection of solutions of each compound in the running buffer into a chip containing covalently immobilized STAT3 resulted in the appearance of a characteristic response. Response unit (RU) values were proportional to compound concentrations within the selected ranges. The SPR assay demonstrated that these three compounds have affinity for immobilized STAT3. The calculated Kd values is 7.93 μM for 13r.
